title: Online Safety
description: This research program focuses on understanding online safety issues among vulnerable social groups.
caption: Image by [Freepik](https://www.freepik.com/free-vector/group-people-hugging-each-other-youth-day-illustrated_8966941.htm#page=13\&query=youth%20engagement\&position=5\&from_view=keyword\&track=ais\&uuid=3f263bf0-61f6-4966-864a-f7351b3a319d)
content: This research program aims to help vulnerable social groups (e.g., children, women) understand the potential harms of emerging technologies and contribute to various measures (including but not limited to policies and regulations) to counter such harms. Our approach is to engage the public in such discussions and decision-making as early as possible. We have conducted a five-country (Singapore, Malaysia, Philippines, India, Bangladesh) comparative study, funded by International Development Research Center, Canada through ideacorp. Recently, we worked closely with UNESCO to run training workshops to implement UNESCO Guideline for the Governance of Digital Platforms and Generative AI.
